notes: Continues training from the Phase 6 pretrained cross-encoder rather than a random init — the ~108-pair training set is far too small to learn passage ranking from scratch, but plausible for nudging an already-strong ranker toward OpsPilot's vocabulary. Negative sampling (hard same-service / easy other-service) is baked into ml/datasets/*.jsonl by ml/build_dataset.py, not configured here.
